question_text: You notice there is play on the handlebar bearing. What must you do?

options.text: Have the play eliminated
Leave the play because it is easier to move the handlebar

correct_answers.text: Have the play eliminated

comment: Having a loose handlebar with some play is dangerous and make your motorcycle more difficult to control, make sure to not have any play to guarantee your safety

question_text: When you move the handlebar, you notice that the handlebar bearing is catching in one place. What must you do?

options.text: Have the catching eliminated
Increase the play of the handlebar bearing to improve track-holding

correct_answers.text: Have the catching eliminated

comment: Having catching in your handelbar bearing makes your motorcycle more difficult to control, make sure to not have any to garantee your safety

question_text: What can play in the handlebar bearing cause?

options.text: It can have a negative influence on road behaviour
Road behaviour is improved
Track-holding is improved

correct_answers.text: It can have a negative influence on road behaviour

comment: Having a loose handlebar with some play is dangerous and make your motorcycle more difficult to control, make sure to not have any play to garantee your safety

question_text: What effect can a defective steering shock absorber have on road behaviour?

options.text: A defective steering shock absorber can cause the steering wheel to shimmy
Roadworthiness can deteriorate
Roadworthiness only deteriorates at low speed

correct_answers.text: A defective steering shock absorber can cause the steering wheel to shimmy
Roadworthiness can deteriorate

comment: A defective steering shock absorber can cause the steering wheel to vibrate/shimmy and decrease the stability and roadworthiness of your motorcycle

question_text: What can decisively impair road behaviour?

options.text: Deflected handlebar bearing
Defective steering shock absorber
Play in the handlebar bearing

correct_answers.text: Deflected handlebar bearing
Defective steering shock absorber
Play in the handlebar bearing

comment: All three will worsen the steering of your motorcycle making it more difficult to control and drive safely

question_text: You notice your motorcycle has poor track-holding. What can be the cause?

options.text: Too much play in the wheel bearings
Deflected backfork

correct_answers.text: Too much play in the wheel bearings
Deflected backfork

comment: Both play in the wheel bearings and deflected back fork can cause your motorcycle to not keep its course and make handling more difficult and less safe

question_text: Your motorcycle no longer keeps the track. What can be defective?

options.text: Bent fork
Bent frame
Defective rear wheel brake

correct_answers.text: Bent fork
Bent frame

comment: A bent fork or frame can make your motorcycle not aligned which will result in difficulty to keep your course

question_text: When you throttle down without disengaging the clutch, your motorcycle no longer keeps to the track. What can be the cause of this?

options.text: Too much play of the fork bearing
Too much play of the rear-wheel bearing
Idle speed too high

correct_answers.text: Too much play of the fork bearing
Too much play of the rear-wheel bearing

comment: Both play in the rear wheel bearing and fork bearing can cause your motorcycle to not keep its course and make handling more difficult and less safe

question_text: You notice that the lever travel of the hydraulic front wheel brake on your motorcycle has become considerably longer. What must you do?

options.text: Have the front wheel brake repaired
Only use the rear wheel brake until the next service
Fill up the brake fluid immediately

correct_answers.text: Have the front wheel brake repaired

comment: It is a sign of a defective front wheel brake which needs to be repaired or replaced

question_text: The mirror holder on your motorcycle is loose. What do you do?

options.text: Fix the mirror holder
Remove the mirror

correct_answers.text: Fix the mirror holder

comment: You should never remove your mirror and need to fix them as they are required at all time to see the traffic behind you

question_text: What can you check on your tyre?

options.text: Uniform wear of the profile
Profile
The age of the tyre

correct_answers.text: Uniform wear of the profile
Profile
The age of the tyre

comment: The driver can check on the tire whether the prescribed tread depth is present and whether the tread has a consistent wear. In addition, the age of the tire can be read off the so-called DOT number.

question_text: When do you need to renew the brake pads?

options.text: If they have become oiled
If they have reached the wear limit
If they have got wet

correct_answers.text: If they have become oiled
If they have reached the wear limit

comment: The car driver must replace the brake pads on the vehicle if they are heavily contaminated by oil. Replacement is also necessary and mandatory when reaching the wear limit.

question_text: Just after driving off, you test the brakes. Why?

options.text: To check the effectiveness of the brakes
To bleed the brake system quickly

correct_answers.text: To check the effectiveness of the brakes

comment: Immediately after the start of the journey you should check the effectiveness of the service brake with a brake test for your own safety. Unlike bleeding the brake system, you can do this yourself by pressing the brake comfortably.

question_text: Why does the brake fluid have to be exchanged according to the instructions of the vehicle manufacturer?

options.text: To ensure the brake system continues to function even under higher stress
To ensure the percentage of water in the brake fluid does not reach a level which is unacceptable
To ensure the brake system does not leak

correct_answers.text: To ensure the brake system continues to function even under higher stress
To ensure the percentage of water in the brake fluid does not reach a level which is unacceptable

comment: The brake fluid also draws water from the air, so the proportion of water in the brake fluid increases over time. Too much water will cause bubbles in the brake fluid. If air bubbles get into the brake line, the braking action can completely fail.

question_text: In which cases is it imperative to test the brakes?

options.text: When you drive a different vehicle
If a vehicle has not been used for a longer period
Each time the engine oil is changed

correct_answers.text: When you drive a different vehicle
If a vehicle has not been used for a longer period

comment: A brake test is always essential if a vehicle has not been moved for a long period of time or if you are taking over a vehicle from someone else. If an oil change has been made on a vehicle, this has no effect on the brake system.

question_text: What do you have to check the tyres on your vehicle at regular intervals for?

options.text: For correct air pressure
For sufficient profile
For external damage

correct_answers.text: For correct air pressure
For sufficient profile
For external damage

comment: At regular intervals you should check the air pressure and tread depth of your vehicle tires. In addition, you should regularly check the tires on your vehicle for external damage.

question_text: If tyre pressure is too high or too low, what can this cause?

options.text: Road behaviour can deteriorate
Tyre wear can increase
Reaction distance can be longer

correct_answers.text: Road behaviour can deteriorate
Tyre wear can increase

comment: If the internal tire pressure is too high or too low, the driving behavior will deteriorate. In addition, the tire wear increases. If the tire pressure is too low, the tire heats up by flexing, while the "soft" tire is excessively compressed and relieved at the footprint. The consequences are an increased fuel consumption and a high rolling resistance, in addition, the driving stability decreases. If the tire pressure is too high, the tire may burst. It is important to check the tire pressure regularly and to take the information recommended by the manufacturer into account. The tire pressure has no influence on the thinking distance.

question_text: You hit a tyre against a hard obstacle with force. What must you do?

options.text: Have the tyres and rim checked immediately
Retighten the wheel bolts

correct_answers.text: Have the tyres and rim checked immediately

comment: Tire and wheel rim must be thoroughly checked before proceeding. Damage to the tire flanks is particularly critical. A deformed wheel rim can cause the tire to slip off the rim. A torn alloy wheel can also have dire consequences. The wheel bolts are not subjected to extraordinary strain, so they do not need to be tightened.

question_text: What happens when you drive with a tyre pressure which is far too low?

options.text: Tyres heat up excessively
Driving stability decreases
Tyre wear decreases

correct_answers.text: Tyres heat up excessively
Driving stability decreases

comment: If you drive with significantly too low tire pressure, the tire may overheat. The low air pressure decreases the driving stability, the vehicle "floats" on the road. A reduction in tire footprint due to concavity in the tread center increases tire wear. Too little tire pressure also increases fuel consumption.

question_text: What can be the cause of a rear light not to work?

options.text: Bulb is defective
Fuse has blown
Starter is defective

correct_answers.text: Bulb is defective
Fuse has blown

comment: If the taillight fails, you should first check the bulb. Even a defective fuse can cause a failure. The starter, however, does not matter because it is not related to the lighting system.

question_text: The control light of your indicator is blinking considerably faster than usual. What can be the cause of this?

options.text: A bulb is defective
The direction indicator switch is defective

correct_answers.text: A bulb is defective

comment: The flashing interval of the control lamp is shortened significantly if a bulb of the turn signal is defective. A fault with the flashing light switch cannot be the cause of the faster flashing.

question_text: Why are you required to have a defective exhaust system repaired immediately?

options.text: Because of the noise pollution
Because parts of the exhaust system can drop on the roadway
Because the engine would overheat

correct_answers.text: Because of the noise pollution
Because parts of the exhaust system can drop on the roadway

comment: You must repair a rusted exhaust system immediately, otherwise parts of the exhaust may fall onto the road. This poses a danger to the other road users. In addition, rusty exhaust parts create unnecessary noise. A rusted exhaust system has no effect on the temperature of the engine.

question_text: The noise of the exhaust has suddenly become louder than usual. What do you do?

options.text: Check the exhaust system
Nothing because nobody is endangered
Renew the engine air filter

correct_answers.text: Check the exhaust system

comment: It is likely that the exhaust system is broken or rusted. A rusted exhaust system can endanger other road users if parts fall off. The exhaust must be checked and repaired. The air filter cannot be the cause of the loud exhaust sound.

question_text: If the horn does not work, what can be the reason?

options.text: Blown fuse
The horn's operating device is defective
Defective starter

correct_answers.text: Blown fuse
The horn's operating device is defective

comment: If the horn of your vehicle does not work, it may be due to a faulty fuse or a faulty switch. A malfunction on the starter has no effect on the function of the horn.

question_text: When braking, you note that your vehicle pulls to the right. What should you do?

options.text: I go to a car workshop
I do not need to fix the problem, as long as I can compensate by counter-steering
I oil the brake pads

correct_answers.text: I go to a car workshop

comment: A defective brake system poses a significant risk, which can lead to accidents. The car driver must have the problem remedied in a specialist workshop.

question_text: What can cause an excessively large brake cylinder stroke?

options.text: A defective automatic slack adjuster
Worn mountings on the transmission system
Excessively high reservoir pressure

correct_answers.text: A defective automatic slack adjuster
Worn mountings on the transmission system

comment: One cause of an excessive brake cylinder stroke is a worn out bearing of the transmission devices and a failure of the automatic slack adjuster. Too high a reservoir pressure does not affect too much brake cylinder stroke.

question_text: What is the permissible minimum tread depth of the main tread of all your vehicle's tyres?
comment: Reifen von Krafträder und PKW müssen eine Profiltiefe von mindesten 1,6 mm aufweisen.

question_text: The brake light of your vehicle is not working. What could be the cause of this?

options.text: The relevant fuse is defective
The bulb is defective
The fill level of the brake fluid is too low

correct_answers.text: The relevant fuse is defective
The bulb is defective

comment: A functioning brake light is significant for the participation in traffic. If the car driver notices a fault on the vehicle, a direct replacement of the corresponding parts must take place. As a cause defective bulbs and broken fuses come into question.

question_text: What must you do if the oil pressure warning light fails to switch off after starting the engine?

options.text: I shut down the engine immediately
I check the engine oil level
I continue driving until the next oil change

correct_answers.text: I shut down the engine immediately
I check the engine oil level

comment: To avoid damage to the engine, stop the engine immediately and check the engine oil level.

question_text: When it is necessary to check the braking system of your motorcycle immediately?

options.text: If the brake fluid level in the reservoir has dropped considerably
If no pressure point is felt when pulling the brake lever
If the brake control light illuminates while you are driving

correct_answers.text: If the brake fluid level in the reservoir has dropped considerably
If no pressure point is felt when pulling the brake lever
If the brake control light illuminates while you are driving

comment: The brake indicator light warns of a defective brake system; if it lights up while driving, you should have the vehicle checked immediately. If the brakes are applied on one side, the vehicle cannot keep to the lane. Have the brake system checked.

question_text: How do you properly perform a visual check to ensure the brake lights are working?

options.text: - the hand and footbrake one after the other
- the hand and footbrake simultaneously
- either the handbrake or the footbrake

correct_answers.text: - the hand and footbrake one after the other

comment: To make sure that both the hand and foot brake lights are working, operate and check them one after the other. If you apply both brakes at the same time, you cannot be sure that both brakes activate the brake light

question_text: One of your wheels has collided heavily against a kerb. What should you note?

options.text: The vehicle should be checked in a garage
The handling of the vehicle could be negatively affected
The tyre could have a slow puncture

correct_answers.text: The vehicle should be checked in a garage
The handling of the vehicle could be negatively affected
The tyre could have a slow puncture

comment:
If you have hit a hard obstacle, you should immediately have the tyre and rim checked for possible damage to ensure safe driving.
If the wheel has been damaged in the collision, it could have a negative effect on the vehicle's handling. If the tyre is only slightly or not obviously damaged, it could still lose air gradually.

question_text: The tail light of your vehicle is not working. What could be the cause of this?

options.text: The relevant fuse is faulty
The bulb is defective
The main beam light switch is faulty

correct_answers.text: The relevant fuse is faulty
The bulb is defective

comment: A blown fuse or a defective bulb can be the cause of a tail light failure.

question_text: How can you detect that a disc brake system has worn brake pads?

options.text: By the wear marks on the brake pad
By a very low fill level in the brake fluid reservoir
By an unusually large amount of looseness in the handbrake lever

correct_answers.text: By the wear marks on the brake pad
By a very low fill level in the brake fluid reservoir

comment: The wear markings on the brake pad serve to check the wear state of the brake pads and to draw your attention to the fact that an exchange of the brake pads is required. Likewise, a low level in the brake fluid container can indicate high wear of the brake pad. Since a lot of brake fluid is directed into the brake cylinder when brake pads are worn.

question_text: Your vehicle’s brake light is not working. What is the right course of action?

options.text: I arrange for a garage to repair the vehicle
I attempt to determine the cause and repair the fault myself
I arrange for the brake fluid to be changed

correct_answers.text: I arrange for a garage to repair the vehicle
I attempt to determine the cause and repair the fault myself

comment: If the lamp is defective, the vehicle's brake light does not work, you should fix it immediately. If only the lamp is defective, you can exchange it yourself or have it replaced by a workshop.

question_text: The exhaust noise has suddenly become unusually loud. What is the right thing to do?

options.text: I immediately check the exhaust system for a faulty mounting
I ensure that any possible damage is promptly repaired
I am allowed to exceed the exhaust noise limits until my next vehicle inspection

correct_answers.text: I immediately check the exhaust system for a faulty mounting
I ensure that any possible damage is promptly repaired

comment: Check the exhaust immediately, e.g. if it is no longer sufficiently secured, this can cause damage to the exhaust, which can make the noise louder. So make sure that any defects are repaired before you continue riding.

question_text: You discover a considerable amount of play on the steering head bearings of your motorbike. What is the right course of action?

options.text: - arrange for the steering head bearings to be properly repaired
- have the quick-release axle of the front wheel properly tightened
- have the handlebars properly tightened onto the clamps

correct_answers.text: - arrange for the steering head bearings to be properly repaired

comment: Significant play in the steering head bearing indicates that the bearing is broken. Have it repaired professionally before you continue riding.

question_text: How can you detect a fault in the steering head bearings of your motorbike?

options.text: - the presence of click stop sounds
- sluggishness in the movement
- some play existing there

correct_answers.text: - the presence of click stop sounds
- sluggishness in the movement
- some play existing there

comment:
The steering head bearing should move smoothly and without detent points or play.
If the handlebars are difficult to turn, for example, this may be due to the steering head bearing. A stiff handlebar makes the motorbike less controllable and must therefore be repaired immediately by a specialist.

question_text: How can you detect your indicator is defective?

options.text: The indicator control lamp flashes faster than normal
By performing a functionality test before moving off
The control lamp for the indicator is permanently illuminated red

correct_answers.text: The indicator control lamp flashes faster than normal
By performing a functionality test before moving off

comment:
Before setting off, check the function of the indicator by operating the indicator lever and checking that it flashes.
If the indicator light flashes faster than usual while riding, an indicator may be faulty. Correct the fault immediately.

question_text: You can see that the free travel of the lever of the hydraulic front-wheel brake has increased considerably. What do you have to do?

options.text: Have the components of the front-wheel brake inspected without delay
Only use the rear-wheel brake until the next inspection
Adjust the travel of the brake lever

correct_answers.text: Have the components of the front-wheel brake inspected without delay

comment: If the free distance on the brake lever of the hydraulic front brake has increased, the brake is probably defective. Have the front brake components checked and repaired immediately.

question_text: The tracking characteristics of your motorbike have deteriorated. What might be the cause of this?

options.text: The chain tensioner was unevenly adjusted
The bearings of the swingarm have become worn
The engine idling speed is set too high

correct_answers.text: The chain tensioner was unevenly adjusted
The bearings of the swingarm have become worn

comment:
The rear swing arm is the movable suspension for the rear wheel. If the bearing of the rear swing arm is worn, the tracking behaviour deteriorates. Replace the bearing.
If the chain tensioners on your motorbike have been adjusted unevenly, the rear wheel may no longer be exactly in line with the front wheel and the tracking behaviour could deteriorate.

question_text: In what road situation can a worn and therefore slippery coupling negatively affect road safety?

options.text: When overtaking on main roads
While merging on the motorway
When performing an emergency braking manoeuvre

correct_answers.text: When overtaking on main roads
While merging on the motorway

comment: You can recognise a worn and slipping clutch by the fact that it no longer engages and you can no longer shift gears properly. This is particularly problematic if you have to accelerate quickly, e.g. when overtaking on country roads or merging onto the motorway. Have the clutch repaired by a workshop.

question_text: You are on a lengthy journey and stop to refuel. What checks should you perform on your motorbike at this time?

options.text: - my tyres
- my lights
- the fastening of my luggage

correct_answers.text: - my tyres
- my lights
- the fastening of my luggage

comment: Before starting longer rides, you should check your lights and tyres. You should also check that your luggage is properly secured before starting off and at every stop.

question_text: A display on your liquid-cooled vehicle indicates an excessively high engine temperature. What should you do now?

options.text: I stop at a suitable place as quickly as possible
I drive on slowly at a high engine speed to improve the engine cooling
I continue onwards in a low gear until I reach my next scheduled driving break

correct_answers.text: I stop at a suitable place as quickly as possible

comment: Stop as quickly as possible at a suitable location and switch off the engine to prevent engine damage due to overheating.

question_text: A display on your liquid-cooled vehicle indicates that the temperature of your coolant is excessively high. What might be the cause of this?

options.text: The radiator is contaminated with dirt
The radiator fan has stopped working
There is a perforation in the radiator system

correct_answers.text: The radiator is contaminated with dirt
The radiator fan has stopped working
There is a perforation in the radiator system

comment:
The reason for an excessively high coolant temperature can be sediment and dirt, as they reduce heat dissipation. 
Coolant can escape through leaks or defective seals. If you have less coolant, it heats up faster. Check your vehicle for visible leaks and have them repaired if necessary.
If the radiator fan is defective, the temperature will rise quickly. Check the radiator fan for blockages and have it replaced by a specialist if necessary.

question_text: What can negatively affect your motorbike's stability on the road?

options.text: Loose steering head bearings
A worn shock absorber
A perforated exhaust system

correct_answers.text: Loose steering head bearings
A worn shock absorber

comment:
A worn steering head bearing leads to play in the steering. The riding stability of your motorbike could be worse, especially when cornering.
If your shock absorbers are worn out, they can no longer compensate for bumps in the road. The grip of the tyres on the road can be reduced and the riding stability of your motorbike deteriorates.

question_text: Your motorbike is liquid-cooled. What should you be sure you do?

options.text: Regularly check the coolant level
Regularly clean the outer surface of the cooler
Top it up with coolant at every refuelling stop

correct_answers.text: Regularly check the coolant level
Regularly clean the outer surface of the cooler

comment:
You should check the coolant level regularly and refill if necessary to prevent the engine from overheating.
Blockages and dirt can impair the function of the radiator. Avoid this by keeping the outer surfaces clean.

question_text: The steering wheel is harder to turn than usual. What can cause this?

options.text: Defective steering gear
Servo-steering is not working
Tyre pressure is too high

correct_answers.text: Defective steering gear
Servo-steering is not working

comment: If the steering is stiff, a defect in the steering gear can be the cause. Also, the failure of power steering can cause the steering wheel to be moved more difficult than normal. You have a similar effect with too low tire pressure, but not too high.

question_text: The brakes on your car are pulling strongly to one side. What effects can this have when you are braking?

options.text: Your car can veer to the side
Longer braking distance
Anti-lock braking system (ABS) fails

correct_answers.text: Your car can veer to the side
Longer braking distance

comment: If the brake on the car has a strong one-sided effect, this has a significant negative effect on the drivability of the vehicle. The vehicle may break sideways into adjacent lanes or start skidding. The braking distance gets longer. The antilocking system remains functional.

question_text: When you press on the brake pedal, it touches the floor. Only when you press on it several times does the pedal travel become shorter. What must you do?

options.text: Park the car immediately
Have the brakes repaired
It is sufficient to fill up the brake fluid

correct_answers.text: Park the car immediately
Have the brakes repaired

comment: If the brake pedal can be pushed down to the floor of the vehicle and the pedal travel becomes shorter after repeatedly stepping on it, there is air in the brake system. This means that the brake has to be serviced and repaired immediately. It's not possible to continue your journey. Also, refilling the brake fluid does not solve the problem.

question_text: The brake lights do not function. What do you do?

options.text: Repair them immediately
Renew the brake fluid

correct_answers.text: Repair them immediately

comment: A defect in the brake lights must be rectified immediately in order not to endanger anyone on the road and to avoid accidents. Defective bulbs or broken fuses can be a cause for malfunctioning brake lights.

question_text: How can you tell while driving that an indicator lamp is not working?

options.text: The indicator signal light will flash faster than usual
You cannot detect a defective indicator lamp while driving

correct_answers.text: The indicator signal light will flash faster than usual

comment: A faulty indicator is noticeable because the indicator light in the instrument display flashes much faster than usual. As a driver, you are able to quickly identify the defect while driving.

question_text: You are driving in the dark with dipped headlights. Oncoming traffic flash their headlights at you. What can this mean?

options.text: The headlamps on your vehicle are set incorrectly and are dazzling
The light range adjustment is not adapted to your vehicle load
Other drivers are telling you to turn on your main beam

correct_answers.text: The headlamps on your vehicle are set incorrectly and are dazzling
The light range adjustment is not adapted to your vehicle load

comment: If the oncoming driver is turning the headlights up and dips them again this is a typical sign that you are dazzling oncoming traffic with your front lights. The reason for this are incorrectly set head lamps or setting the headlight range in a way that does not correspond to the load condition. Do not misunderstand turning the headlights up and dipping them again as an invitation to turn on the high beam of your car.

question_text: The glass in your left outside mirror is broken. What do you do?

options.text: Renew the mirror glass
Do not renew the mirror glass because you can still partly see to the rear

correct_answers.text: Renew the mirror glass

comment: On each vehicle, a left exterior mirror is mandatory. If the glass has cracked, you must replace the mirror immediately, even if all other mirrors are working properly. Only then can you continue your journey.

question_text: The windscreen washer does not work. What can be the reason for this?

options.text: No water in the reservoir
Defective fuse
Blocked jets

correct_answers.text: No water in the reservoir
Defective fuse
Blocked jets

comment: If the windscreen washer does not work, it may be due to clogged nozzles or a defective fuse. However, it is also possible that there is no more water in the storing tank and therefore the windscreen washer does not work.

question_text: Too little water is coming out of the windscreen washer jets. What can cause this?

options.text: Jets are partly blocked
Defective washer pump
Too much water in the reservoir

correct_answers.text: Jets are partly blocked
Defective washer pump

comment: The windshield washer nozzles of your vehicle may be partially clogged if too little water comes out of them. The cause of the malfunctioning windscreen washer could also be a defect of the water pump. Too much water is not considered a cause of the error.

question_text: The windscreen wipers do not wipe clean? What can be the reason for this?

options.text: The windscreen wiper blades are worn
There is an oil film on the windscreen
The windscreen heating is defective

correct_answers.text: The windscreen wiper blades are worn
There is an oil film on the windscreen

comment: If the wipers do not wipe clean, this may be due to an oil film on the windscreen. Even worn windscreen wiper blades can affect the function of the windscreen wipers. A defect in the window heater, however, has no effect on it.

question_text: The windscreen wipers on your car do not function. What can be the cause of this?

options.text: Blown fuse
Windscreen wiper motor defective
Too much water in the windscreen washer

correct_answers.text: Blown fuse
Windscreen wiper motor defective

comment: If the windscreen wipers on your car do not work, it may be due to a faulty engine in the windscreen washer system. Even a blown fuse can be the cause. By contrast, too much water is not responsible for any failure.

question_text: A safety belt lock does not close. What do you do?

options.text: Have the lock repaired
Nothing because the seat is equipped with an airbag
Drive at a low speed

correct_answers.text: Have the lock repaired

comment: If the lock of a seatbelt does not close properly, you must first take care of the repair or get a replacement. Without proper operation of the seat belts driving even at low speed is not allowed because intact seat belts are mandatory.

question_text: A safety belt does not roll up automatically. What can be the reason for this?

options.text: Safety belt is twisted
Automatic retractor is defective
Seat adjustment is defective

correct_answers.text: Safety belt is twisted
Automatic retractor is defective

comment: It sometimes happens that the belt is twisted and jammed in the guide provided when unbuckling. If this happens it is not possible for the strap to roll up anymore. In addition, the device may have a defect. It then has to be repaired or replaced.

question_text: Your car’s steering wheel wobbles while you are driving. What can be the reason?

options.text: Wheels are unbalanced
Shock absorbers are defective
Wheel suspension-spring is damaged

correct_answers.text: Wheels are unbalanced
Shock absorbers are defective
Wheel suspension-spring is damaged

comment: If the steering wheel flutters while driving, defective shock absorbers may be the reason. They prevent vertical movements of the tires. Damage of the suspension can also be a possible cause. The same flutter effect is also caused by wheels with an imbalance.

question_text: What can be the reason for a tyre on front axle wearing on one side more than the other?

options.text: Track alignment not in order
Steering axle is bent

correct_answers.text: Track alignment not in order
Steering axle is bent

comment: Basically, there are two causes for the different degrees of wear of the front tires: Either the wheel alignment is not correct or an axle guide is bent. You should immediately correct the wheel alignment or carry out a repair of the axle guide.

question_text: What can cause excessive wear on tyres?

options.text: Damage to the wheel suspension-spring
Incorrect tyre pressure
Mounting a front spoiler

correct_answers.text: Damage to the wheel suspension-spring
Incorrect tyre pressure

comment: Improper tire pressure and suspension damage are the most common causes of excessive tire wear. Tire pressure refers to too little air pressure. This increases the abrasion. The attachment of a front spoiler does not lead to tire damage.

question_text: Whilst driving, your vehicle pulls to the right. What can be the reason for this?

options.text: Steering axle bent
Wheel alignment not in order
Loose steering shock absorber

correct_answers.text: Steering axle bent
Wheel alignment not in order

comment: If your vehicle pulls to the right while driving, the wheel position may be responsible. But even a bent axle guide can be the cause. In contrast, the steering damper usually has no influence on the directional stability of your vehicle.

question_text: What is the impact on your vehicle if you operate the steering wheel while stationary?

options.text: The tyre tread can be damaged
A heavy strain is exerted on the front axle mechanism
Steering is made easier

correct_answers.text: The tyre tread can be damaged
A heavy strain is exerted on the front axle mechanism

comment: Attempting to steer your vehicle while standing requires much more effort than when it's rolling. This increased effort is transferred to the entire steering including the track rod. This is more stressed than when steering while driving.
